mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diag_precompute_job ( tenant_id, job_code, module_code, status_code, priority, request_json, request_hash, read_range_type, read_start, read_end, window_types, force_rebuild, max_retry, retry_count, progress_percent, current_stage, total_windows, done_windows, rows_read, rows_written, orchestrator_status, module_progress_json, submitted_by, submitted_time ) VALUES ( #{row.tenantId}, #{row.jobCode}, #{row.moduleCode}, #{row.statusCode}, #{row.priority}, #{row.requestJson}, #{row.requestHash}, #{row.readRangeType}, #{row.readStart}, #{row.readEnd}, #{row.windowTypes}, #{row.forceRebuild}, #{row.maxRetry}, #{row.retryCount}, #{row.progressPercent}, #{row.currentStage}, #{row.totalWindows}, #{row.doneWindows}, #{row.rowsRead}, #{row.rowsWritten}, #{row.orchestratorStatus}, #{row.moduleProgressJson}, #{row.submittedBy}, ISNULL(#{row.submittedTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, SYSUTCDATETIME()) )
mapper.update: UPDATE diag_precompute_job SET progress_percent = #{row.progressPercent}, current_stage = #{row.currentStage}, total_windows = #{row.totalWindows}, done_windows = #{row.doneWindows}, rows_read = #{row.rowsRead}, rows_written = #{row.rowsWritten}, module_progress_json = COALESCE(#{row.moduleProgressJson}, module_progress_json), update_time = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND job_id = #{row.jobId}

UPDATE diag_precompute_job SET status_code = #{row.statusCode}, current_stage = #{row.currentStage}, retry_count = COALESCE(#{row.retryCount}, retry_count), started_time = COALESCE(#{row.startedTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, started_time), finished_time = COALESCE(#{row.finishedTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, finished_time), error_message = #{row.errorMessage}, orchestrator_status = COALESCE(#{row.orchestratorStatus}, orchestrator_status), module_progress_json = COALESCE(#{row.moduleProgressJson}, module_progress_json), update_time = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND job_id = #{row.jobId}
mapper.select: SELECT job_id AS jobId, tenant_id AS tenantId, job_code AS jobCode, module_code AS moduleCode, status_code AS statusCode, priority, request_json AS requestJson, request_hash AS requestHash, read_range_type AS readRangeType, read_start AS readStart, read_end AS readEnd, window_types AS windowTypes, force_rebuild AS forceRebuild, max_retry AS maxRetry, retry_count AS retryCount, progress_percent AS progressPercent, current_stage AS currentStage, total_windows AS totalWindows, done_windows AS doneWindows, rows_read AS rowsRead, rows_written AS rowsWritten, orchestrator_status AS orchestratorStatus, module_progress_json AS moduleProgressJson, submitted_by AS submittedBy, submitted_time AS submittedTime, started_time AS startedTime, finished_time AS finishedTime, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM diag_precompute_job WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND job_id = #{jobId}

SELECT job_id AS jobId, tenant_id AS tenantId, job_code AS jobCode, module_code AS moduleCode, status_code AS statusCode, priority, request_json AS requestJson, request_hash AS requestHash, read_range_type AS readRangeType, read_start AS readStart, read_end AS readEnd, window_types AS windowTypes, force_rebuild AS forceRebuild, max_retry AS maxRetry, retry_count AS retryCount, progress_percent AS progressPercent, current_stage AS currentStage, total_windows AS totalWindows, done_windows AS doneWindows, rows_read AS rowsRead, rows_written AS rowsWritten, orchestrator_status AS orchestratorStatus, module_progress_json AS moduleProgressJson, submitted_by AS submittedBy, submitted_time AS submittedTime, started_time AS startedTime, finished_time AS finishedTime, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM diag_precompute_job WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND job_code = #{jobCode}

SELECT TOP 1 job_id AS jobId, tenant_id AS tenantId, job_code AS jobCode, module_code AS moduleCode, status_code AS statusCode, priority, request_json AS requestJson, request_hash AS requestHash, read_range_type AS readRangeType, read_start AS readStart, read_end AS readEnd, window_types AS windowTypes, force_rebuild AS forceRebuild, max_retry AS maxRetry, retry_count AS retryCount, progress_percent AS progressPercent, current_stage AS currentStage, total_windows AS totalWindows, done_windows AS doneWindows, rows_read AS rowsRead, rows_written AS rowsWritten, orchestrator_status AS orchestratorStatus, module_progress_json AS moduleProgressJson, submitted_by AS submittedBy, submitted_time AS submittedTime, started_time AS startedTime, finished_time AS finishedTime, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM diag_precompute_job WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND request_hash = #{requestHash} AND status_code IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'RETRYING') ORDER BY submitted_time DESC, job_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION_PARAMS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'jobId' AND PARAMETER_VALUE = CAST(#{jobId} AS NVARCHAR(64))

SELECT TOP 1 job_id AS jobId, tenant_id AS tenantId, job_code AS jobCode, module_code AS moduleCode, status_code AS statusCode, priority, request_json AS requestJson, request_hash AS requestHash, read_range_type AS readRangeType, read_start AS readStart, read_end AS readEnd, window_types AS windowTypes, force_rebuild AS forceRebuild, max_retry AS maxRetry, retry_count AS retryCount, progress_percent AS progressPercent, current_stage AS currentStage, total_windows AS totalWindows, done_windows AS doneWindows, rows_read AS rowsRead, rows_written AS rowsWritten, orchestrator_status AS orchestratorStatus, module_progress_json AS moduleProgressJson, submitted_by AS submittedBy, submitted_time AS submittedTime, started_time AS startedTime, finished_time AS finishedTime, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM diag_precompute_job WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND request_hash = #{requestHash} ORDER BY submitted_time DESC, job_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diag_precompute_window ( tenant_id, job_id, window_key, window_type, period_start, period_end, compare_start, compare_end, status_code, progress_percent, current_stage, data_version, retry_count, rows_read, rows_written, started_time, finished_time, error_message ) VALUES ( #{row.tenantId}, #{row.jobId}, #{row.windowKey}, #{row.windowType}, #{row.periodStart,jdbcType=DATE}, #{row.periodEnd,jdbcType=DATE}, #{row.compareStart,jdbcType=DATE}, #{row.compareEnd,jdbcType=DATE}, #{row.statusCode}, #{row.progressPercent}, #{row.currentStage}, #{row.dataVersion}, #{row.retryCount}, #{row.rowsRead}, #{row.rowsWritten}, #{row.startedTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{row.finishedTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{row.errorMessage} )
mapper.update: UPDATE diag_precompute_window SET status_code = #{row.statusCode}, progress_percent = #{row.progressPercent}, current_stage = #{row.currentStage}, data_version = #{row.dataVersion}, retry_count = COALESCE(#{row.retryCount}, retry_count), rows_read = #{row.rowsRead}, rows_written = #{row.rowsWritten}, started_time = COALESCE(#{row.startedTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, started_time), finished_time = COALESCE(#{row.finishedTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, finished_time), error_message = #{row.errorMessage}, update_time = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND window_id = #{row.windowId}
mapper.select: SELECT window_id AS windowId, tenant_id AS tenantId, job_id AS jobId, window_key AS windowKey, window_type AS windowType, period_start AS periodStart, period_end AS periodEnd, compare_start AS compareStart, compare_end AS compareEnd, status_code AS statusCode, progress_percent AS progressPercent, current_stage AS currentStage, data_version AS dataVersion, retry_count AS retryCount, rows_read AS rowsRead, rows_written AS rowsWritten, started_time AS startedTime, finished_time AS finishedTime, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM diag_precompute_window WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY window_id ASC

SELECT window_id AS windowId, tenant_id AS tenantId, job_id AS jobId, window_key AS windowKey, window_type AS windowType, period_start AS periodStart, period_end AS periodEnd, compare_start AS compareStart, compare_end AS compareEnd, status_code AS statusCode, progress_percent AS progressPercent, current_stage AS currentStage, data_version AS dataVersion, retry_count AS retryCount, rows_read AS rowsRead, rows_written AS rowsWritten, started_time AS startedTime, finished_time AS finishedTime, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM diag_precompute_window WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND window_id = #{windowId}

SELECT TOP 1 window_id AS windowId, tenant_id AS tenantId, job_id AS jobId, window_key AS windowKey, window_type AS windowType, period_start AS periodStart, period_end AS periodEnd, compare_start AS compareStart, compare_end AS compareEnd, status_code AS statusCode, progress_percent AS progressPercent, current_stage AS currentStage, data_version AS dataVersion, retry_count AS retryCount, rows_read AS rowsRead, rows_written AS rowsWritten, started_time AS startedTime, finished_time AS finishedTime, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM diag_precompute_window WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND job_id = #{jobId} AND status_code = 'PENDING' ORDER BY window_id ASC

SELECT t.event_id AS eventId, t.tenant_id AS tenantId, t.job_id AS jobId, t.window_id AS windowId, t.event_time AS eventTime, t.event_level AS eventLevel, t.event_stage AS eventStage, t.event_message AS eventMessage, t.payload_json AS payloadJson, t.create_time AS createTime FROM ( SELECT event_id, tenant_id, job_id, window_id, event_time, event_level, event_stage, event_message, payload_json, create_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY event_id DESC) AS rn FROM diag_precompute_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND job_id = #{jobId} ) t WHERE t.rn <= COALESCE(#{limit}, 200) ORDER BY t.event_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM diag_precompute_job j CROSS APPLY ( SELECT TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.classLevel') AS INT) AS classLevel, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.classNo') AS classNo, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.className') AS className, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.deptId') AS deptId, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.retailTypeId') AS retailTypeId, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.businessCircleId') AS businessCircleId, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.deptGroupId') AS deptGroupId, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.storeNo') AS storeNo ) reqj OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 * FROM diag_precompute_window w1 WHERE w1.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND w1.job_id = j.job_id ORDER BY w1.window_id DESC ) w

SELECT j.job_id AS jobId, j.request_hash AS requestHash, j.status_code AS statusCode, j.progress_percent AS progressPercent, j.current_stage AS currentStage, j.submitted_by AS submittedBy, COALESCE(j.submitted_time, j.create_time) AS submittedTime, reqj.classLevel AS classLevel, reqj.classNo AS classNo, reqj.className AS className, reqj.deptId AS deptId, COALESCE(scopeInfo.deptName, reqj.deptId) AS deptName, reqj.retailTypeId AS retailTypeId, COALESCE(scopeInfo.retailTypeName, reqj.retailTypeId) AS retailTypeName, reqj.businessCircleId AS businessCircleId, COALESCE(scopeInfo.businessCircleName, reqj.businessCircleId) AS businessCircleName, reqj.deptGroupId AS deptGroupId, COALESCE(scopeInfo.deptGroupName, reqj.deptGroupId) AS deptGroupName, reqj.storeNo AS storeNo, COALESCE(scopeInfo.storeName, reqj.storeNo) AS storeName, j.read_start AS periodStart, j.read_end AS periodEnd, w.compare_start AS compareStart, w.compare_end AS compareEnd, w.data_version AS dataVersion, snapshotInfo.snapshotId AS snapshotId, COALESCE(userInfo.nick_name, userInfo.user_name) AS createByName FROM diag_precompute_job j CROSS APPLY ( SELECT TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.classLevel') AS INT) AS classLevel, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.classNo') AS classNo, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.className') AS className, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.deptId') AS deptId, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.retailTypeId') AS retailTypeId, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.businessCircleId') AS businessCircleId, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.deptGroupId') AS deptGroupId, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.storeNo') AS storeNo ) reqj OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 * FROM diag_precompute_window w1 WHERE w1.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND w1.job_id = j.job_id ORDER BY w1.window_id DESC ) w OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 d.preorgname AS deptName, d.store_format_name AS retailTypeName, d.business_circle_name AS businessCircleName, d.store_group_name AS deptGroupName, d.store_name AS storeName FROM base_department d WHERE (reqj.storeNo IS NULL OR reqj.storeNo = '' OR d.store_no = reqj.storeNo) AND (reqj.deptId IS NULL OR reqj.deptId = '' OR d.preorgcode = reqj.deptId) AND (reqj.retailTypeId IS NULL OR reqj.retailTypeId = '' OR d.store_format_no = reqj.retailTypeId) AND (reqj.businessCircleId IS NULL OR reqj.businessCircleId = '' OR d.business_circle_no = reqj.businessCircleId) AND (reqj.deptGroupId IS NULL OR reqj.deptGroupId = '' OR d.store_group_no = reqj.deptGroupId) ORDER BY CASE WHEN reqj.storeNo IS NOT NULL AND reqj.storeNo != '' AND d.store_no = reqj.storeNo THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, d.store_no ASC ) scopeInfo OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 o.id AS snapshotId FROM diag_result_overview o WHERE o.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND o.query_hash = j.request_hash AND o.data_version = w.data_version ORDER BY o.snapshot_time DESC, o.id DESC ) snapshotInfo LEFT JOIN sys_user userInfo ON userInfo.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND userInfo.user_id = j.submitted_by
ORDER BY
reqj.classNo j.read_start w.compare_start COALESCE(j.submitted_time, j.create_time) COALESCE(j.submitted_time, j.create_time)
ASC DESC , j.job_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT j.job_id AS jobId, j.request_hash AS requestHash, j.status_code AS statusCode, j.progress_percent AS progressPercent, j.current_stage AS currentStage, j.submitted_by AS submittedBy, COALESCE(j.submitted_time, j.create_time) AS submittedTime, reqj.classLevel AS classLevel, reqj.classNo AS classNo, reqj.className AS className, reqj.deptId AS deptId, reqj.deptId AS deptName, reqj.retailTypeId AS retailTypeId, reqj.retailTypeId AS retailTypeName, reqj.businessCircleId AS businessCircleId, reqj.businessCircleId AS businessCircleName, reqj.deptGroupId AS deptGroupId, reqj.deptGroupId AS deptGroupName, reqj.storeNo AS storeNo, reqj.storeNo AS storeName, j.read_start AS periodStart, j.read_end AS periodEnd, w.compare_start AS compareStart, w.compare_end AS compareEnd, w.data_version AS dataVersion, snapshotInfo.snapshotId AS snapshotId, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS createByName FROM diag_precompute_job j CROSS APPLY ( SELECT TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.classLevel') AS INT) AS classLevel, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.classNo') AS classNo, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.className') AS className, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.deptId') AS deptId, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.retailTypeId') AS retailTypeId, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.businessCircleId') AS businessCircleId, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.deptGroupId') AS deptGroupId, JSON_VALUE(j.request_json, '$.storeNo') AS storeNo ) reqj OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 * FROM diag_precompute_window w1 WHERE w1.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND w1.job_id = j.job_id ORDER BY w1.window_id DESC ) w OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 o.id AS snapshotId FROM diag_result_overview o WHERE o.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND o.query_hash = j.request_hash AND o.data_version = w.data_version ORDER BY o.snapshot_time DESC, o.id DESC ) snapshotInfo
ORDER BY
reqj.classNo j.read_start w.compare_start COALESCE(j.submitted_time, j.create_time) COALESCE(j.submitted_time, j.create_time)
ASC DESC , j.job_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
